name: OUTSTRETCHED_PIERCED_HANDS
canonical: Risen Christ, both arms stretched wide forward in welcome, palms turned outward and open. Each open palm bears one small round dark healed scar at its centre, old skin closed flat and level with the surface of the palm. Fingers smooth and unmarked, ordinary natural skin tone, plain even daylight, calm and reverent.
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
